articles.summary: Lunai Bioworks, Inc. (NASDAQ: LNAI) ("Lunai" or the "Company") today issued this correction to the press release the Company distributed on August 27, 2026 under the headline "Lunai Bioworks (NASDAQ: LNAI) Names Six Broker-Dealers in Expanded Naked Short Selling Suit." The sole correction is to the hyperlink identifying where a copy of the Company's Second Amended Complaint can be found. No other statement in the original release has changed, and the Company is not disclosing any new information in this correction. A copy of the Second Amended Complaint, filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware (Civil Action No. 26-549-CFC), is available on the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at https://s201.q4cdn.com/863337820/files/doc_news/2026/Aug/27/attachments/Complaint-SecondAmendedRedacted-ECF037-082826-C.pdf or directly through the court's public docket. articles.title: Lunai Bioworks (NASDAQ: LNAI) Issues Correction to Press Release Regarding Second Amended Complaint
